name: Give Thanks
overview: Scripture calls believers to give thanks to God continually, recognizing His enduring mercy and goodness as the foundation for praise. The Psalms emphasize entering God's presence with thanksgiving and magnifying His name through song, while the New Testament encourages giving thanks in all circumstances through prayer in the name of Jesus Christ. This attitude of gratitude is not only an expression of worship but also a means of casting anxieties upon God with thankful hearts.
